name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: Parallel-first engineering orchestration with four Luna workers by default, safe token-first fallback, a shared operations leader, and token-free native status.

interface.shortDescription: Low-cost Luna work with visible Sol governance.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune defaults to Sol-defined four-worker Luna/max speed bursts behind a start-once, await-once MCP boundary, with eight-way as an explicit experiment and token-first as a safety fallback. Parallel writes use detached Git worktrees and deterministic safe-apply gates. One shared Luna/high operations leader manages long-running sessions and compresses results while Sol retains planning, architecture, risk, integration review, and final acceptance. A native Windows panel shows token-free live status.
defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator with its default four-way parallel routing for this engineering task.
Use $luna-pool-orchestrator in token-first fallback mode because parallel write isolation is unsafe here.
